name: buildarch
description: 100% free workspace architecture & design analyzer. Supports Java, C#/.NET, C/C++, Delphi/Object Pascal, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Angular, Node.js, Dart/Flutter, PowerShell, Perl, Go, Rust, Kotlin, Swift, PHP, Ruby, Shell/Bash, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, gRPC Proto, OpenAPI.

buildarch.include.description: Glob patterns to include in workspace architecture analysis.

buildarch.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from workspace architecture analysis.

buildarch.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to process.

buildarch.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum file size in KB to analyze in detail.

buildarch.ai.provider.description: AI provider model for BuildArch: Workspace AI.

buildarch.ai.maxTokens.description: Maximum token budget cap for AI enrichment.

buildarch.ai.dryRun.description: If true, show estimated tokens and prompt for confirmation before executing AI enrichment.

buildarch.languages.enabled.description: Enabled language IDs for analysis (* for all).

buildarch.customRulePacks.description: File paths to custom regex rule-pack JSON files.

buildarch.encoding.fallback.description: Fallback text encoding when UTF-8 decoding fails.

buildarch.report.title.description: Custom title for generated HTML architecture reports.

buildarch.report.theme.description: Default visual theme for generated report.

buildarch.report.includeFilePaths.description: Include relative file paths and evidence line numbers in generated report.

buildarch.report.redactSecrets.description: Automatically redact potential secret values and tokens in report.
